request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for browser extension, web/PWA, iOS, Android, and beta channel

Backend infrastructure and operations including multi-region servers, Cardano nodes, DBSync/indexers, application servers, metadata aggregation, transaction submission endpoints, monitoring, alerting, and incident response
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public channels, ecosystem project support, and Eternl Wiki updates
Governance tooling including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting enhancements, and proposal creation tooling
Independent audits of treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027 plus oversight metrics covering balances, conversion rates, transaction hashes, and repayment hashes
Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, enhanced hardware wallet support, and enhanced wallet data export
request.what: 12 months of operations, maintenance, and improvements for the Eternl non-custodial Cardano light wallet, including frontend and backend maintenance and development, backend infrastructure, user support, day-to-day operations, audits of treasury fund use, and oversight metrics.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet available on web, browser extension, Android, and iOS.
The proposal asks for ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 in annual costs for 12 months.
The requested budget funds 6.0 FTE across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE, with budget shares of 55% frontend, 25% backend, 5% support, 13% admin, and 2% audits.
Eternl has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.
If roughly 5,500 users, about 4.2% of the stated install base, buy a Pro plan, Eternl says that income would fully cover the $420,000 annual cost.
After withdrawal, Eternl says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins in a public company wallet and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

The proposal commits to independent audits by an unaffiliated party in February 2027 and August 2027 covering receipt, custody, conversion, spending, remaining balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and refunds or repayments.

Eternl says it will assess repayment every December and June, using surplus stablecoins plus paid-plan income above $420,000 to repay the proposal value and later donating 50% of Pro-plan income above $420,000 until an additional $210,000 is donated.
Eternl claims 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.

If treasury funding is not received and paid licenses are insufficient beyond August, Eternl says it may reduce developers, scale down to essential maintenance, shift focus outside Cardano, remove the free option, and provide fewer new features and less support.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for a 12-month Eternl sustainability plan administered by Tastenkunst GmbH, with stated operations, development, support, audit, transparency, and repayment commitments, but several adoption and impact claims are asserted without in-document evidence.
